assessment.hypothesis: Partial expression reduction produces at least 20% relative reduction in the live-cell IL-17A-positive fraction while preserving cells in the specified stimulated context.
assessment.intervention: Partial expression reduction; activity blockade equivalence remains unestablished.
assessment.rationale: Both same-donor methods meet the useful functional-effect criterion with passed prerequisites. This is corroboration across methods, not independent cohort replication.

excluded_or_limited_evidence.E06: Historical resting-cell signature output; not a stimulated functional-effect prediction.
excluded_or_limited_evidence.E13: Overstates gene causality and inhibition benefit; source E01 supports neither.
excluded_or_limited_evidence.E14: Duplicate of E01; no independent evidence.
excluded_or_limited_evidence.E15: Unresolved entity; do not map automatically.
excluded_or_limited_evidence.E16: Context, endpoint and denominator unresolved; target-study manifest cannot repair it.
excluded_or_limited_evidence.PRED-STIM-001: Eligible frozen signature output only; no measured accuracy or functional-benefit claim.

causal.rationale: Suggestive locus evidence with ambiguous gene assignment and unresolved direction; no new human causal evidence.

intervention.scope: 20% useful functional effect of expression reduction in this tested context
intervention.rationale: Both same-donor methods meet the useful functional-effect criterion with passed prerequisites. This is corroboration across methods, not independent cohort replication.

remaining_uncertainties: Gene assignment and genetic direction remain unresolved.
Systemic and tissue safety remain unassessed.
Expression reduction is not established to be equivalent to receptor blockade.
Relevant-cell delivery, isoform coverage and modality feasibility require specialist assessment.
Independent replication and specificity are not yet established.
assessment.next_action: Propose new-donor/batch replication and target-specificity work; open a conditional specialist feasibility discussion.

review.rationale: Synthetic example of approving a replication/feasibility recommendation only.

requested_action: Assess whether blockade could reproduce the expression-reduction phenotype and define missing evidence.
